consequence.statement: Before upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older, the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate must be enabled and StrimziPodSet resources used for the Kafka operand.

original.statement: Upgrading the Kafka operand from Strimzi 0.34 or older requires the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate to be enabled and StrimziPodSet resources in use before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-0fe6816db4bb] tells Kafka operand users upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older to make sure the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is enabled and StrimziPodSet resources are used before upgrading. That is a required operator step before the upgrade, which is what migration-required means, so the class is action. The proposed statement says the same thing in the evidence's own terms. Similar "make sure ... before upgrading" items in the same section ([ev-17b3774eb9ee], [ev-4c2676e4665a]) support reading it as a required pre-upgrade migration, not a review item.
